entries.answer: Two files generated: **.replit** and **replit.nix**, provisioning CUDA 12.8.1-equivalent (`cudaPackages_12_8`) toolkit/cudnn/cublas on top of Python 3.11, plus custom-built Zig 0.14.1 and Futhark 0.26.4 derivations fetched from their official upstream release tarballs.[1][2]
